I see the core tension here: the coding domain is artificially forced into 08 > 12 via a single low-weight ISBN item, while the other two domains naturally favor 12 > 08 > 06. This creates an unstable benchmark that will likely mis-rank models on holdout data, especially if any model fails 08 > 12 on ISBN edge cases but otherwise performs well.

Given the remaining time and the fact that we can't add new 08 > 12 items without risking more harm, the development optimum is still to keep the current setup.
